name: METAMIZOL SODIUM / BUTYLHYOSCINE 2.5G/20MG INJECTABLE SOLUTION 1 AMPOULE
description: Metamizole, also known as dipyrone, is an analgesic that also works by reducing fever and muscle spasms. It is indicated for the treatment of severe acute pain (postoperative, post-traumatic, colic, neoplastic) or high fever that does not respond to other treatments. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
